scene: The tram speeds inside a bustling multi-transit terminal above the arcade.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of a multi-level transit deck. Far left, a spherical cloud cable pod hangs open on a cable. Left of centre stands the Pacific Islander man with ukulele. Centre, a wooden solar-sail junk floats moored to the rail. Far right, a dragon-shaped maglev train hums on a lit platform.
shown: A round cloud cable pod waiting on a suspension cable, far left. Door open.
A wooden solar-sail junk moored at an open dock, centre. Gangplank lowered.
A sleek green maglev dragon train parked at a glowing platform, far right.
